newsitem.title: USA: Oglethorpe, Morgan Stanley finalize power deal.
newsitem.headline: Oglethorpe, Morgan Stanley finalize power deal.

text.p: Oglethorpe Power Corp said Wednesday it has finalized an agreement for Morgan Stanley Capital Group to supply up to half of Oglethorpe's long-term, system-wide power requirements.
Under the agreement, Morgan Stanley will also have the right to market excess power from half of Oglethorpe's own resources, which total about 5,000 megawatts.
The deal, which has a term of up to eight years, is the second of its kind over the past six months.
Last November, Oglethorpe also closed a deal with LG&E Power Marketing, a unit of LG&E Energy, to supply the other half of Oglethorpe's power.
Atlanta-based Oglethorpe Power Corp provides electricity to 39 of Georgia's 42 customer-owned Electric Membership Corporations (EMCs).
